34883-barrington-volume-2-of-2.title: Barrington Volume 2 Of 2
34883-barrington-volume-2-of-2.creator: Charles James Lever
34883-barrington-volume-2-of-2.description: A book by Charles James Lever. "You are initiated at once into our Irish ways, Fifine," said Miss Barrington. "All that you will see here is in the same style. Let that be repaired this evening, sir, and at your own cost," whispered she to Darby, into whose hand at the same moment Peter was pressing a crown piece.

arxiv-2105-06260.title: Numerical Modelling of Neutral Boundary-Layer Flow across a Forested Ridge
arxiv-2105-06260.creator: John Tolladay, Charles Chemel
arxiv-2105-06260.description: Abstract Forest canopies have been shown to alter the dynamics of flows over complex terrain. Deficiencies have been found when tall canopies are represented in numerical simulations by an increase in roughness length at the surface. Methods of explicitly modelling a forest canopy are not commonly available in community numerical weather prediction models.

arxiv-2304-12316.title: Constraining the Onset Density for the QCD Phase Transition with the Neutrino Signal from Core-collapse Supernovae
arxiv-2304-12316.creator: Noshad Khosravi Largani ∗, Tobias Fischer †, Niels-Uwe F. Bastian
arxiv-2304-12316.description: Abstract The occurrence of a first-order hadron-quark matter phase transition at high baryon densities is investigated in astrophysical simulations of core-collapse supernovae, to decipher yet incompletely understood properties of the dense matter equation of state (EOS) using neutrinos from such cosmic events.

arxiv-2308-04232.title: A Comparative Study of Image-to-Image Translation Using GANs for Synthetic Child Race Data
arxiv-2308-04232.creator: Wang Yao, Muhammad Ali Farooq, Joseph Lemley, Peter Corcoran
arxiv-2308-04232.description: Abstract The lack of ethnic diversity in data has been a limiting factor of face recognition techniques in the literature. This is particularly the case for children where data samples are scarce and presents a challenge when seeking to adapt machine vision algorithms that are trained on adult data to work on children.

arxiv-2310-09805.title: Pulsation in hot main sequence stars: comparison of observations with models
arxiv-2310-09805.creator: L. A. Balona
arxiv-2310-09805.description: Abstract Comparison of TESS observations with models of pulsating hot main sequence stars reveals several problems. The frequencies in δ \delta Scuti stars at a given temperature do not match those predicted by models. A large fraction of δ \delta Scuti stars are hotter than the predicted hot edge of the instability strip.

arxiv-2411-07290.title: The formation of multiples in small- N subclusters
arxiv-2411-07290.creator: Hannah E. Ambrose, A. P. Whitworth
arxiv-2411-07290.description: Abstract We explore the relative percentages of binary systems and higher-order multiples that are formed by pure stellar dynamics, within a small subcluster of N N stars. The subcluster is intended to represent the fragmentation products of a single isolated core, after most of the residual gas of the natal core has dispersed.

arxiv-2501-09207.title: Relationship between total reflection and Fabry-Perot bound states in the continuum
arxiv-2501-09207.creator: Zitao Mai, Ya Yan Lu
arxiv-2501-09207.description: Abstract Bound states in the continuum (BICs) have interesting properties and important applications in photonics. A particular class of BICs are found in Fabry-Perot (FP) cavities formed by two parallel periodic dielectric layers separated by a distance h h . A periodic dielectric layer can totally reflect a plane incident wave with a particular frequency and a particular wavenumber.

pmc-12448080.title: Physiotherapy Reduces Pain and Alters Fatty Acid Biomarkers in Women with Chronic Non-Specific Low Back Pain
pmc-12448080.creator: Zhou Zhang, Xin Li, Wen Tang, Hao Xie, Hong-Jiang Wang, Hao-Yu Xie, Chu-Huai Wang
pmc-12448080.description: BackgroundChronic nonspecific low back pain (cNLBP) represents the most prevalent musculoskeletal disorder encountered in clinical practice, constituting approximately two-thirds of all chronic low back pain cases. Epidemiological studies have identified significant gender differences in the incidence of cNLBP, with women exhibiting a slightly higher prevalence and reporting greater pain severity compared to men.

pmc-12466754.title: New Insights in blaKPC Gene Mobilization in Pseudomonas aeruginosa: Acquisition of blaKPC-3 and Identification of a New Tn2-like NTE Mobilizing blaKPC-2
pmc-12466754.creator: Deisy Abril, Juan Bravo-Ojeda, Julio-Cesar Garcia, Aura Lucia Leal-Castro, Carlos Humberto Saavedra-Trujillo, Johana Madroñero, Rosa-Helena Bustos, Ricaurte Alejandro Marquez-Ortiz, Zayda Lorena Corredor Rozo, Natasha Vanegas Gómez, Javier Escobar-Pérez
pmc-12466754.description: Carbapenem-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a major cause of healthcare associated infections in hospitalized patients and what is more warring with reduced therapeutic options. The KPC is a powerful enzyme capable of hydrolyzing the carbapenems, described first in Klebsiella pneumoniae and it already has found in P. aeruginosa.

pmc-12522216.title: Comparison of Worth Four Dots (W4D) and Bagolini Striated Lenses in adult suppression detection
pmc-12522216.creator: Chieh-Yueh Lin, Guan-Cheng Lin, Kun-Shiang Chen, Li-Te Yin
pmc-12522216.description: BackgroundSuppression is an adaptive response in which visual information from one eye is inhibited to prevent visual conflict. This phenomenon is commonly observed in individuals with strabismus, anisometropia, or amblyopia. Clinically detecting suppression is essential for assessing binocular vision and conducting visual training. The Worth Four Dots (W4D) and Bagolini Striated Lenses (BAG) are widely used tools.

pmc-12607472.title: Dual-Mode Plasmonic Colorimetric/Photothermal Aptasensor for OTA: Based on a Mn2+-Powered DNA Walker for Mediating AuNB Growth
pmc-12607472.creator: Zhi Li, Quan Liu, Hongwei Zhang, Yu Xiao, Ming Li, Xiaojie Chai, Jianlong Ji, Jindong Li, Shu Qin, Ksenija Radotić, Dragana Bartolić
pmc-12607472.description: The sensitive and efficient detection of ochratoxin A (OTA) is critical for protecting agricultural ecosystems and public health. A dual-mode plasmonic colorimetric/photothermal aptasensor, based on a Mn2+-powered DNA walker for mediating gold nanobipyramid (AuNB) growth, is proposed for OTA detection in this study.

pmc-13180837.title: Assessing the impact of climate-induced biodiversity loss on respiratory health through text classification
pmc-13180837.creator: Yuting Deng
pmc-13180837.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionThe complex interplay between environmental dynamics, biodiversity loss, and public health necessitates advanced methodologies for quantifying and interpreting their interactions. Respiratory health, highly sensitive to environmental changes, requires particular attention as ecosystems undergo transformations driven by climate stressors.

pmc-13240586.title: The Effect of Iron, Zinc, and Calcium Trunk and Root Injections on Fruit Characteristics and Leaf Mineral Content in “Mazafati” Date Palm
pmc-13240586.creator: Bahareh Damankeshan, Bahman Panahi, Ali Salehi Sardoei, Mansour Ghorbanpour
pmc-13240586.description: This study evaluated the effects of trunk and root injections of iron (Fe), zinc (Zn), and calcium (Ca) on fruit characteristics and leaf mineral composition of “Mazafati” date palm ( Phoenix dactylifera L. cv. “Mazafati”) under orchard conditions in Kerman Province, Iran.

pmc-13257924.title: Bioactive Fillers in Bulk-Fill Composite Resins: A Comprehensive Review of the Effects on Polymerization Shrinkage Behavior and Mechanical Performance
pmc-13257924.creator: Vlad Constantin, Ionut Luchian, Ionut Taraboanta, Teona Anamaria Tudorici, Nicoleta Tofan, Florinel Cosmin Bida, Florin Razvan Curca, Dana Gabriela Budala, Dragos Ioan Virvescu, Andrei Georgescu
pmc-13257924.description: Polymerization shrinkage remains a primary cause of marginal failure in posterior composite restorations, contributing to interfacial gap formation and secondary caries development. Bioactive filler technologies represent a paradigm shift, offering simultaneous stress reduction and therapeutic ion release through engineered matrix–filler interactions.

pmc-13477713.title: Spontaneous Ureteric Rupture Secondary to Ureteric Calculus: A Case Report
pmc-13477713.creator: Anthony Awolowo Thomas, Samuel Ayokunle Dada
pmc-13477713.description: Spontaneous ureteric rupture is a rare clinical entity defined by the extravasation of urine from the ureter in the absence of external trauma or instrumentation. It is most frequently associated with obstructive urolithiasis.We report the case of a 37-year-old male presenting with acute, severe abdominal pain secondary to spontaneous proximal ureteric rupture from an obstructing calculus.

pmc-13668012.title: DeepLNM: A Multimodal Model for Predicting Lymph Node Metastasis in Colorectal Cancer
pmc-13668012.creator: Zhengyu Zhang, Chengyu Lu, Zhen Wang, Zhijian Cen, Yangshu Zhou, Danyi Li, Qi Xie, Bingbing Li, Shujing Guo, Zhijun Gan, Er‐ran Zhu, Jinbang Li, Aihetaimu Aimaier, Rui Mao, Weihao Qiu, Chenglong Zhao, Ying Tan, Xiaolin Liu, Huiting Ma, Tiansu Geng, Peiyue Wu, Huijun Du, Yu Wang, Yueping Liu, Li Lian
pmc-13668012.description: Accurate assessment of lymph node metastasis (LNM) is critical for prognostic stratification and treatment selection in colorectal cancer (CRC), yet imaging and routine pathology can yield false‐negative/false‐positive results. We propose DeepLNM, a multi‐center foundation model for LNM prediction in CRC, evaluated with retrospective, external, prospective, and user study evidence.
